name: Talimun
faction: Tale of the Moon (Vandahl Trading Company)
weapons: Reason magic (Fire, Thunder, Bolganone, Thoron, Excalibur)
personality: A frivolous, flirtatious merchant who is always chewing cinnamon, but who hides grand ambitions and an appetite for dangerous adventures.
story: One of Dagda's greatest merchants and head of the Vandahl Trading Company, he is half-human and half Child of the Goddess (around 573 years old) and collects Drake's Treasure. He regularly clashes with Ursula over spending.

personalSkill.name: Swashbuckler's Luck
personalSkill.effect: Lck+3. Upgrades at Lv35 to Swashbuckler's Luck+: Lck+5 to unit and allies.

joins: Automatically in Part III: Salvation, First Section, on all routes. Guides advise completing his Part I paralogue to be safe.

build.role: Curse caster and team Lck aura
build.notes: Arrives with Long-Night Katara and Aaron's Rod: Katara to storage, Rod to Orchel in Sec 2. Bloodmark: Diadem of Duality. Join class ?.

guide.role: Curse caster: halves a boss's Hit or AS from 10 tiles; Lck +5 to every ally
guide.summary: His Blaze curses reach 10 tiles: Slowing Curse halves a boss's AS so the strikers double, Collapsing Curse halves its Hit before the wall takes the turn. Each curse adds 1 to an Underworld gauge with no reset, so count them; between curses he casts Thoron from 3 tiles.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: curse the boss first, then let the strikers in; cast Bolganone or Thoron with what's left. Stay out of melee: he is a caster with no Avo tools. Swashbuckler's Luck+ stays on every map.
keys: Store Long-Night Katara in Sec 2 Free Time: as a caster he never swings it.
Hand Aaron's Rod to Orchel in Sec 2; wear the Magic Staff (Mag +3, no Curse).
Slowing Curse on the boss first (halves AS), then send in the doublers.
Def/Res Curse on a high-Def boss: the physical hitters then face its Res.
Count his curses: each adds 1 gauge and nothing resets it.
watch: Weight: Bolganone 8 + Magic Staff 3 = 11 over Bld ?; Thoron Wt ?. Doubled by fliers: the Staff comes off first.
Gauge: Underworld, no reset. Curse arts +1 each, cursed gear +1 per combat. Burst halves max HP.
Undead: Katara and Rod can zero his hit (Offset Curse). Both are off from Sec 2.
Join class and level ?: Swashbuckler's Luck+ needs Lv 35; Winds of Victory level ?.
Melee: no dodge tools. End turns 3+ tiles from foes; Thoron reaches 3.

decisions.pick: Katara to storage, Aaron's Rod to Orchel (Sec 2)
decisions.why: His curse arts already add 1 each with no reset; the Rod adds 1 more per combat. Orchel wears it at no gauge cost (Automaton), and the Magic Staff keeps Mag +3 here at Wt 3 instead of 8.
decisions.else: Keep the Rod on a short map (5 combats or fewer) if Orchel sits out

decisions.pick: Ovate on join, Druid at Lv 45 (Black A)
decisions.why: His Black list runs to Thoron (A) and Excalibur (S); Druid adds Mag +30 and doubled casts. White stops at B (Nosferatu), so Wiseman and Valkyrium are out.

stages.goal: Curse support: Slowing or Collapsing Curse on the boss from 10 tiles; Lck +5 to all allies.
why: Sec 1: arrives on Turn 7 with Katara + Rod (2 per combat); fine for one short map
Underworld Boon: no answer of his own; cast from within 2 of Eshmel
Join class ?: take Ovate in Sec 2 Free Time (Black B) if he isn't one
stages.exit: Lv 45 and Black A: Druid exam (Master License)
